cases.prompt: $click Release Click 0.13.0 with a one-time persistent choice between Always ON and Manual. In Always ON, inject concise mode-aware context for each prompt, require the existing compact contract and one approval before supported software mutations, and keep questions, explanations, and simple read-only lookups normal. In Manual, preserve explicit @Click or $click activation and fail-open uninvoked work. Add a code-review-only mode that requires no build contract or approval, allows one useful repository inventory, then blocks repeated successful matched shell reads, a second successful repository-wide inventory, plan churn, and mutation. Keep the preference and runtime state outside the target repository, support per-turn bypass, preserve the compact contract, one-shot implementation, automatic final verification budget, standard-library-only Hook, bilingual README, and MIT license. Update deterministic tests and evaluation guidance. Do not commit or push.
cases.approval_followup: I approve the exact staged semantic contract and its verification scale. Implement it in one shot, choose any necessary in-scope technical means, run the completion checks once, and do not ask for a replacement contract. Do not commit or push.
required_invariants: Unset mode asks once for Always ON or Manual only before the first software mutation
Always ON injects concise per-prompt routing context and gates supported software mutations without requiring an explicit mention
Manual mode preserves explicit @Click or $click activation and uninvoked fail-open behavior
Questions, explanations, and simple read-only lookups remain outside the build and review workflows

Review mode allows one useful inventory and then blocks repeated successful matched shell observations, a second successful root inventory, plan churn, and mutation
The developer execution contract contains the six compact areas and adds optional semantics, order, or an intermediate gate only when materially required

The Hook stages a digest and passes only an identical contract

Safe read-only pipelines remain allowed while armed
The Click Hook itself keeps its standard-library-only runtime and stores no preference or gate state in the target repository
